title.zh: Solana moves Alpenglow into testnet as SOL nears January highs
title.en: Solana moves Alpenglow into testnet as SOL nears January highs

current_state.zh: Solana 的 Alpenglow 共识升级已在 devnet 和 testnet 两个公共测试网络上运行，供开发者测试，主网启动尚未排期。
current_state.en: Solana's Alpenglow consensus upgrade is running on both public test networks, devnet and testnet, for developer testing, with mainnet launch not yet scheduled.

updates.what_changed_zh: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.
updates.what_changed_en: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.
updates.background_zh: Alpenglow 是 Solana 自 TowerBFT 以来首次重大共识层替换，由 Anza 于 2025 年 5 月提出。它延续了此前的性能升级：Solana 本月激活 Transaction V1，将最大交易大小从 1,232 字节提升至 4,096 字节，其 slot 时间路线图也逐步把目标从 400 毫秒压缩至 200 毫秒。
updates.background_en: Alpenglow is Solana's first major consensus replacement since TowerBFT and was presented by Anza in May 2025. It follows other performance work: Solana activated Transaction V1 this month, lifting maximum transaction size to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, and its slot-time roadmap has progressively cut the target from 400 milliseconds toward 200 milliseconds.
updates.market_impact_zh: Alpenglow 对市场的传导路径主要体现在结算延迟上：更快的最终确认可能影响 Solana 上 DEX 与代币化现实世界资产等场所的市场结构，以及验证者和基础设施服务商承担的运营要求。报道指出，SOL 在本周接近 120 美元后于发稿时报约 117 美元，过去一个月上涨约 25%，而网络上的现实世界资产规模在 9 月初达到约 46 亿美元。
updates.market_impact_en: Alpenglow's transmission path to markets runs mainly through settlement latency: faster finality could affect market structure for Solana-based venues such as DEXs and tokenized real-world assets, as well as the operational requirements placed on validators and infrastructure providers. The article notes SOL traded around $117 after nearing $120 this week, up roughly 25% over the past month, and that real-world assets on the network reached about $4.6 billion in early September.
